answer: Re-attestations are stored in copper and island lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the vertex graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1866 impostors cost 124 times the honest price and take 20 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
